Question ID: STAT_U01_L07_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.STQ.1

Which display best shows the distribution of daily reading minutes for one group of students?

feedback.text: A two-way table is for two categorical variables.
A pie chart shows categorical parts of a whole.
A segmented bar graph compares categorical proportions.
A histogram is appropriate for one numerical variable when the goal is to show distribution.

feedback.text: In a bar chart, taller bars represent larger counts or frequencies.

Bar charts summarize categories, not numerical pairs.

Question ID: STAT_U01_L07_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.DVD.3

feedback.text: 50% is only one segment.
30% is only one segment.

A complete segmented bar represents the whole group.
